milestone: Horizen Pilot — one fact, several observers
problem: One fact — Nakamoto is registered — had several observers, each reading a different source, disagreeing. Every instance looked like a new bug and was the same bug. The journey stepper drove from `/state`, which resolved the AGENT's own persona and listed its receipts; every journey receipt is written with personaId = the acting operator, so receiptRefs came back empty and Register could never render COMPLETE however completely it had succeeded.
observedFailure: Master Journey advanced to Verify while Verify said "no tokenId yet" — the stepper read the receipt, Verify read the `registry_assets` projection, and the projection write had silently failed.
Claim refused with `aigentqube-moneypenny` while claiming Nakamoto, because `MarketaEligibilityView` never sent `agentSlug` and the server used DEFAULT_REGISTRABLE_AGENT_SLUG.

Ladder "Awaiting confirmation", card "not yet registered" and banner "registered — tokenId 8798" rendered on ONE screen, because the panel held the tokenId three ways and fed its ladder from the weakest.

The Evidence-receipts drawer (scoped to the operator persona) listed the horizen_agent_registered receipt while the stepper driven by `/state` showed Register unfinished — the contradiction visible on one screen.
rootCauses: Two independent Supabase writes (`createRegistrationReceipt`, `updateRegistryAssetBinding`) with nothing making them one transaction; any reader depending on both landing will eventually be wrong.
`updateRegistryAssetBinding` had three silent-return points and a discarded `.update()` error — it "succeeded" while writing nothing.
The `/state` route re-implemented the receipt query instead of consuming the canonical reader, so it was a second observer with its own (wrong) key.
A server default was substituted for an operator selection the surface had visibly made.
resolution: One shared resilient reader with a named fallback and a `fromReceiptFallback` / `fallbackSource` flag, so a stuck write stays diagnosable rather than silently worked around forever.
Added `findAgentReceiptRefs` to the canonical receipt reader — subject-keyed, returning ids and action types only, never the persona-scoped body — and moved `/state` onto it.

Gave the ladder an explicit precedence (confirmed external consequence > confirmed receipt > pending request > expired request > prepared local state) and removed every reset-to-null path from the confirmation cache.
Every abandoned write now logs `[HORIZEN BINDING]` with the ids that failed to persist.
Both `agentSlug` call sites (GET refresh and POST prove-control) now carry the operator's selection.
rejectedApproaches: Render both answers and let the operator decide which panel is lying.
Treat a later failed read as evidence that a confirmed fact was reversed.
Keep the server default as a substitute for an absent client selection.
